hook: Borrow gold to win now, then pay it back with kills and sales, and every repayment buffs your flock.
loop: Borrow gold to buy more, building Debt with interest.
Debt powers fighters; Skimmers pay it off by killing.
Every repayment fires Repaid: buffs and fills the Ledger.

growth.line: Permanent buffs on every repayment, several a round from Skims; Ledger payoffs speed up late.

feel.early: Borrow for tempo, then a broke turn.
feel.mid: Tier 4 multipliers make each repayment count.
feel.late: Ledger and Skim capstones snowball the whole tribe.

stars.why: Move it to choose when the big bill lands.
Owe more, hit harder, then skim the Debt back.
Every sale, from any tribe, becomes a repayment.

builds.name: The Racket
builds.line: Skimmers turn kills into repayments; Seven and Sorrow and Joy buff.

builds.name: The Bill Comes Due
builds.line: Mr Magpie holds Debt past 10, then Arne cashes the lump.

builds.name: The Pawnshop
builds.line: Uncle Jack turns every sale into a repayment and a buff.

liked: All three picked Mr Magpie: moving one unit decides when the bill lands.
Debt as a fight resource, high in fights, paid off by kills, is new.
worries: Arne with Thought and Memory on a Mr Magpie bill: a huge one-turn swing.
Seven, Tower Raven and Sorrow and Joy may snowball won fights with Skims.
changed: One Repaid: trigger word; every Debt repaid, by kill or sale, fills the Ledger.
Slate-Drinker Rook now grows when repaid, instead of only losing gold.
Penny Jackdaw borrows 3 to buy a unit; Mr Magpie needs real Debt.
verdict: Fun 6.7, distinct 7.0, ranked best of three Syndicate designs; for players who like timing borrows, bills and sales.
